messages.author: 24377a638cb7d6b7
messages.subject: Error in rep(list.dirs(dirs[i], full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE),  :    invalid 'times' argument
parts:
Hi,
I have a problem with renaming raw camera trap images and keep getting this error:

Error in rep(list.dirs(dirs[i], full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE),  : 
  invalid 'times' argument 

So here is the code I used:

> library(camtrapR)
This is camtrapR 2.0.3 (CURRENT)
> Sys.which("exiftool")   # this should return some path, e.g. "C:\\windows\\exiftool.exe"
                   exiftool 
"C:\\WINDOWS\\exiftool.exe" 
> wd <- "C:/Users/User/Desktop/Kuala Lompat April 2021"
> setwd(wd)
> cams <- read.csv("KualaLompat_April2021.csv")
> View(cams)
> wd_rawImages     <- "C:/Users/User/Desktop/Kuala Lompat April 2021/imageRAW"
> wd_renamedImages <- "C:/Users/User/Desktop/Kuala Lompat April 2021/imageRENAMED"
> rename_table <- imageRename(inDir                = wd_rawImages,
+                             outDir               = wd_renamedImages,
+                             hasCameraFolders     = TRUE,
+                             keepCameraSubfolders = FALSE,
+                             copyImages           = TRUE)
Beberas:  135 images      |====                |   20%
Error in rep(list.dirs(dirs[i], full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE),  : 
  invalid 'times' argument

Thanks for any help, much appreciated.

Bazilah

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Error in rep(list.dirs(dirs[i], full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE), : invalid 'times' argument
parts:
Hi Bazilah,
this is probably a known bug which arises when you state  hasCameraFolders = TRUE, but all station directories only have one camera directory each. Is that the case here?
I hope I can fix that soon and incorporate it in the next release. 
In the meantime it might be enough to create an empty camera directory in one of the station directories to avoid this bug. Or possibly get rid of the camera directories and set hasCameraFolders = FALSE, if that is possibly with your study design. 
Best regards,
Jürgen

Hi Bazilah, 

Thank you for pointing this issue out! I faced a similar issue yesterday. Renaming images, when done with a single species folder/one camera directory/no subdirectory, followed the name of the station (not the species folder within!). 

Hi Jürgen,

Creating random blank folders with random species names solved the issue. Thank you! 

Regards, 

Akash
